description.narrative: Contributo volontario all'UNIDO che si occupa dello sviluppo industriale dei Paesi. Gli obiettivi sono quelli di sostenere e supportare lo sviluppo industriale e tecnologico dei Paesi in via di sviluppo attraverso partenariati e sinergie. Il mandato dell'Organizzazione è principalmente coerente con l'SDG 9 (Industria, innovazione e infrastrutture). L'obiettivo è quello di sostenere e supportare lo sviluppo industriale e tecnologico dei Paesi in via di sviluppo attraverso partenariati e sinergie.

Voluntary contribution to UNIDO that is responsible for the industrial development of countries. The objectives are to support and sustain the industrial and technological development of developing countries through partnerships and synergies. The mandate of the Organization is mainly consistent with SDG 9 (Industry, innovation and infrastructure). The goal is to support and sustain the industrial and technological development of developing countries through partnerships and synergies.

tag.narrative: Build resilient infrastructure, promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and foster innovation

By 2030, upgrade infrastructure and retrofit industries to make them sustainable, with increased resource-use efficiency and greater adoption of clean and environmentally sound technologies and industrial processes, with all countries taking action in accordance with their respective capabilities

Increase the access of small-scale industrial and other enterprises, in particular in developing countries, to financial services, including affordable credit, and their integration into value chains and markets

Promote inclusive and sustainable industrialization and, by 2030, significantly raise industry’s share of employment and gross domestic product, in line with national circumstances, and double its share in least developed countries

Support domestic technology development, research and innovation in developing countries, including by ensuring a conducive policy environment for, inter alia, industrial diversification and value addition to commodities
